reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is connecting to Qichacha MCP services through OAuth and exposing authorized enterprise-data tools.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到企查查 MCP 服务，并提供授权范围内的企业数据工具。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Qichacha MCP services through OAuth and exposes enterprise-data tools within the authorized scope.

capabilities: Initiates an OAuth authorization flow with Qichacha using Authorization Code and PKCE
Opens a browser for authorization and receives a local loopback callback
Persists, refreshes, and revokes OAuth access and refresh tokens
Mounts authorized Qichacha MCP data services and sends bearer tokens to their resource URLs
Provides conversation tools for connection, status, and disconnection management
